exercises.instructions: Choose the correct alternative to complete each sentence.

questions.question: ________ it snow yesterday?
questions.explanation: 'Yesterday' indicates past time, so we use 'Would' (past tense of will). 'Will' is for present/future. 'Shall' is used with I/we for suggestions — neither matches past time. 'Yesterday' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'Would' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ you like a coffee?
questions.explanation: 'Would' is used for polite requests and offers. 'Will' is less polite. 'Shall' is used with I/we for suggestions — it does not fit 'you'. 'Would' ကို ယဉ်ကျေးတဲ့မေးခွန်းတွေမှာ သုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ go to the cinema today.
questions.explanation: 'Today' indicates present/future time, so we use 'won't' (will not). 'Wouldn't' is for past/hypothetical. 'Shan't' is formal British — 'won't' is the standard form. 'Today' ဆိုတာ ဒီနေ့ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'won't' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________ probably arrive soon.
questions.explanation: 'Soon' indicates future time, so we use 'will'. 'Would' is for past/hypothetical. 'Shall' is used with I/we — not with 'he'. 'Soon' ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'will' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: We ________ play if we had a ball.
questions.explanation: 'If we had a ball' is a Type 2 conditional (unreal). In Type 2, we use 'would + V1'. 'Will' is for Type 1 (real) conditionals. 'Shall' is for suggestions with I/we. 'If we had a ball' က Type 2 conditional ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'would' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Sam said he ________ come.
questions.explanation: 'Sam said' indicates reported speech. In reported speech, 'will' changes to 'would', so the negative is 'wouldn't'. 'Won't' is for direct speech. 'Shan't' is formal. 'Sam said' က reported speech ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'wouldn't' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: They ________ paint it as you want.
questions.explanation: This is a straightforward statement about a future action. 'Will' is used for future promises. 'Would' is for past/hypothetical. 'Shall' is for suggestions with I/we. 'Will' ကို အနာဂတ်ကတိပြုချက်အဖြစ်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: If I were you, I ________ go there.
questions.explanation: 'If I were you' is a Type 2 conditional (unreal). We use 'would + V1' in the result clause. 'Won't' is for Type 1 conditionals. 'Shan't' is formal. 'If I were you' က Type 2 conditional ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'wouldn't' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: They ________ come tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 'Tomorrow' indicates future time, so we use 'will'. 'Would' is for past/hypothetical. 'Shall' is for suggestions with I/we. 'Tomorrow' ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'will' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ be on time for the meeting.
questions.explanation: This is a statement about a future intention or promise. 'Will' is used for future commitments. 'Would' is for past/hypothetical. 'Shall' can be used with I/we but 'will' is more natural for promises. 'Will' ကို အနာဂတ်ကတိပြုချက်အဖြစ်သုံးပါ။

questions.question: He said he ________ read that book.
questions.explanation: 'He said' indicates reported speech. In reported speech, 'will' changes to 'would', so the negative is 'wouldn't'. 'Won't' is for direct speech. 'Shan't' is formal. 'He said' က reported speech ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'wouldn't' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ you stop smoking this year?
questions.explanation: 'This year' indicates a future time frame. 'Will' is used for future decisions. 'Would' is for polite requests/hypothetical. 'Shall' is used with I/we for suggestions. 'This year' ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'Will' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Today ________ probably be a nice day for me.
questions.explanation: 'Today' indicates present/future time. 'Will' is used for predictions about the future. 'Would' is for past/hypothetical. 'Shall' is for suggestions with I/we. 'Today' ဆိုတာ ဒီနေ့ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'will' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: If Paula doesn't go, I ________ go either.
questions.explanation: 'If Paula doesn't go' is a Type 1 conditional (real future). We use 'will + V1' in the result clause. 'Wouldn't' is for Type 2 (unreal). 'Shan't' is formal. 'If Paula doesn't go' က Type 1 conditional ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'won't' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: My mum said that she ________ be there by 8 o'clock.
questions.explanation: 'My mum said' indicates reported speech. In reported speech, 'will' changes to 'would'. 'Will' is for direct speech. 'Shall' is for suggestions. 'My mum said' က reported speech ဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'would' ကိုသုံးပါ။
